facts.text: README lists the published 'scan' topic with type sensor_msgs/LaserScan and describes it as the 2D laser scan of the 0-angle ring.
The source includes the generated sensor_msgs/msg/laser_scan.hpp header.
The main function constructs a plain rclcpp::Node named 'ydlidar_node'.
The node creates a sensor_msgs::msg::LaserScan publisher on the relative topic name 'scan' with rclcpp::SensorDataQoS().

ret holds the result of laser.initialize() and then laser.turnOn(); the main loop runs while ret and rclcpp::ok() hold, calls laser.doProcessSimple(scan, hardError), and publishes a LaserScan on every successful sample.
After the main loop ends the node prints a stopping message, calls laser.turnOff() and laser.disconnecting(), and shuts rclcpp down.
The published header stamp splits scan.stamp into seconds and nanoseconds, and header.frame_id is set from the local frame_id value.

The range and intensity arrays are sized as int((max_angle - min_angle) / angle_increment + 1); each point is written at the std::ceil index of its angle offset, and a point whose index falls outside the array is dropped.
The vendored SDK's doProcessSimple sets the range to 0.0 for an ignored angle, and the range and intensity to 0.0 for a range that is not valid.
The node's local frame_id defaults to 'laser_frame' in source and is then read from the declared frame_id parameter.
The launch file passes the node a root namespace '/'.
README shows the resolved topic name '/scan' in the ros2 topic echo example.
The launch file carries an Apache License 2.0 header with Copyright 2020, EAIBOT.
The vendored SDK's licence file is a BSD licence text of the YDLIDAR Team.

safe_state.description: The node is a passive LaserScan publisher: this package only observes its scan topic and exposes no actuation, stop or reset path.
